Turkish · 1,000 words

Turkish words 101–200

Turkish words 101 to 200, by how often they're used, each with its meaning in English, an example sentence and, for verbs, the main forms (he, she or it). 88 of them are taught in the lessons of the course.

Learn them with spaced repetition, Anki-style: open the flashcards. Free, no account needed.

Overview1–100101–200201–300301–400401–500501–600601–700701–800801–900901–1000
  1. 101
    içnoun

    inside, interior; in (içinde)

    Anahtar çantanın içinde.

    The key is in the bag.

    his, her, its içi

    Mostly with possessive and case endings: içinde (inside), içine (into), içinden (out of).

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 9: Where and when: postpositions

  2. 102
    duymakverb

    to hear; to feel (an emotion)

    Sesini duyamıyorum.

    I can't hear you.

    aorist duyar · present duyuyor · past duydu · future duyacak

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 8: Definite objects· Conjugation

  3. 103
    öldürmekverb

    to kill

    Bu sıcak beni öldürecek!

    This heat is going to kill me!

    aorist öldürür · present öldürüyor · past öldürdü · future öldürecek

    The causative of ölmek (to die): literally to make die.

    B1· Conjugation

  4. 104
    yolnoun

    road, way; path; journey

    Bu yol çok uzun.

    This road is very long.

    Yolda = on the way. İyi yolculuklar! = Have a good trip!

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 7: To and from

  5. 105
    eğerconjunction

    if

    Eğer yağmur yağarsa evde kalırız.

    If it rains, we'll stay home.

    Optional: the conditional suffix -sA on the verb already says if.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 9: Conditionals

  6. 106
    çünküconjunction

    because

    Gelemedim, çünkü hastaydım.

    I couldn't come because I was sick.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 4: Questions and negation

    pekiinterjection

    OK, all right; well then, so

    Peki, şimdi ne yapıyoruz?

    OK, so what do we do now?

    artıkadverb

    now, from now on; (not) anymore; finally

    Artık burada çalışmıyorum.

    I don't work here anymore.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 5: Can and can't

    ölmekverb

    aorist diler · present diliyor · past diledi · future dileyecek

    Özür dilerim = I'm sorry (literally I ask for pardon).

About this list

The words are ranked by how often they come up in film and TV dialogue, so the list leans towards spoken Turkish. Words are listed in their dictionary form (verbs in the infinitive, gelmek), names and fragments are left out, and ranks are estimates rather than exact counts.

The order of the list is adapted from the 2018 Turkish list of FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave, made from the OpenSubtitles2018 corpus via OPUS, and is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. The meanings, example sentences and notes are original to Daily Turkish.
